title: 10th International Symposium on Transport Network Resilience - INSTR 2026
body: Participated in the 10th International Symposium on Transport Network Resilience (INSTR 2026), held in Lyon, France, and presented the work "Metropolis-Scale Resilient and Trustworthy Traffic Flow Inference Using Multi-Source Data". The presentation PDF is available for [online preview](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1gdPNoG5PYkeWxQwx_S9P8o-wscktkFaN/view?usp=sharing).

title: Present at TRB Annual Meeting
body: 101st Annual Meeting of Transportation Research Board, Washington DC. High-Resolution Queue Profile Estimation at Signalized Intersections Based on Extended Kalman Filter.

title: Present at MT-ITS Conference
body: 2021 7th International Conference on Models and Technologies for Intelligent Transportation Systems. Queue Profile Identification at Signalized Intersections with High-Resolution Data from Drones.
